200.description: One page of the reservations created against this demandRef (possibly empty), ordered by (createdAt, id).

schema.description: One keyset page of reservations (REST guideline section 3.3), ordered by (createdAt, id).

ownerRef.description: Owner whose stock the reservation holds (ADR 0045). Omitted for fleet-owned stock.

lineNo.description: The order line this reservation is for (ADR 0036), 1 to 2147483647 (32-bit). Omitted when unknown (a reservation made before the field existed, or by a client that does not send it).

items.description: A specific StockUnit and quantity a Reservation drew from, plus the pick location: the bin that StockUnit sits in (ADR 0025).

binId.description: Pick location — the bin the allocated StockUnit sits in, i.e. where a picker goes to fulfil this allocation. Always present for allocations made by this version; omitted only for a legacy allocation whose bin could not be backfilled.

items.title: Allocation

createdAt.description: Timestamp this reservation was created, RFC 3339.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp this reservation auto-expires if never confirmed or revoked, RFC 3339.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, to be passed back unchanged as `cursor`. Absent on the last page.

schema.title: ReservationPage

400.description: The demandRef query parameter is missing or empty (missing-demand-ref), `limit` is not an integer between 1 and 500 (invalid-limit), or `cursor` is not a page token this API issued (invalid-cursor).

schema.description: RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs) error shape, used for every non-2xx response across this service. `type` is `https://errors.inventory-storage.warehouse-systems.dev/<slug>`; every slug is documented as a response example on the operation(s) that can return it, and the mapping from typed domain error to (status, slug, title) lives in one lookup table (`problemCatalog` in internal/adapters/inbound/http/errors.go, ADR 0005).

type.description: A URI identifying the error category (does not need to resolve). Unique per distinct error category in this service.

title.description: Fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code as an integer (RFC 7807 requirement).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced this error.
